messages:
Sam C: Heads up — multiple model pulls in eu-west1 are failing right now. Pods hitting 502 from artifact proxy and Envoy resets. Saw target 127.0.0.1:8080 in the egress route. Anyone else seeing this?
Anya P: Which service/pod and logs you have? can you paste the envoy upstream/route snippet?
Sam C: Repro and logs below. short snippet: 
```
[2026-03-15T10:14:03Z] envoy misc: upstream reset: connection failure to 127.0.0.1:8080
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
via: 1.1 envoy
x-forwarded-host: artifact-proxy.local
```
Sam C: We're trying to pull s3://artifacts-eu/model-abc.tgz via our artifact gateway. curl inside pod shows CONNECT -> 127.0.0.1:8080 before TLS handshake.
Infra Bot: policy-audit: egress-policy-change detected; policy_id=policy-847 applied by Jordan R at 2026-03-15T10:12:17Z :warning:
Jordan R: I pushed policy-847 to enforce artifact fetches through artifact-proxy for auditing/compliance. I thought the proxy was a separate service, didn't realize the sidecar had a local listener on 127.0.0.1 that matches same host. my bad.
Mike L: Sounds like a redirect loop: egress policy rewrites host header to artifact-proxy.local -> Envoy routes to local-proxy cluster (127.0.0.1:8080) -> local-proxy forwards outbound to artifact domain -> gets intercepted again by sidecar rules -> loop/reset. We need to exclude loopback or mark cluster passthrough.
Sam C: Quick repro command: 
```sh
kubectl exec -it deploy/model-puller -n inference -- curl -v https://artifacts.redwood-models/eu-west/model.tgz
* CONNECT 127.0.0.1:8080 HTTP/1.1
* Received HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```
Anya P: Hotfix proposal: update policy-847 to exclude match on hostnames that resolve to 127.0.0.1 OR add a condition to not rewrite for pods in namespace "model-serving". Also add `egress.passthrough: true` for artifact cluster.
Jordan R: I'll revert policy-847 in prod-eu now, then we can push a safer rule. adding CI regression test for loopback rewrites.
Ops Oncall: Revert executed in prod-eu, observed 4/4 successful pulls within 2 minutes on the affected nodes. Rolling to remaining nodes. :thumbsup:
Deploy Bot: deploy:policy-revert-2019877000 completed by Jordan R — status: success
Sam C: Confirmed. Model pulls recovered, latency back to baseline. Opening postmortem PM-4321 to document root cause and add tests for sidecar egress rules.
Mike L: Also filing infra ticket to blacklist 127.0.0.1/loopback from egress-rewrite actions by default.
Anya P: Thanks all. small follow-ups: add validation to policy UI to warn on loopback host rewrites, and add a canary for policy changes in eu that runs artifact pulls.
Sam C: Agreed. I'll add the canary run to the policy change playbook.
